finding.text: A `place` line with `edit: "improve"` still overwrites the owner's words on screen: `ux/Dictate/Widget.js:583` (`patch_piece(hit.bubble, …, { text })`) swaps the raw text for the assistant's, and the raw words survive only in `said`, which nothing draws. The brief asked for this check ("whether a `place` line moves it… whether a `{"p-<id>": {"text": …}}` edit overwrites it"), but the cause log in `session.jsonl` covers only the Question hide. The fixture's `place` text is identical to the raw text (`raw-stays-fixture.jsonl:3`), so the test can't catch an overwrite. Either draw the raw words beside the improved ones, or record why an improved text counts as "visible", and add a fixture line whose improved text differs.

The second commit is missing: the brief asks for one line in `ux/Dictate/improvements.jsonl` (through the `item` tool) about the writer. The file's last line is from `mastermind-v1-order`, and the branch has only the two commits `568254a08` and `d28d84a3a`.

There is no `shots/` folder in this task dir. The brief asks for one headless 400x860 shot of V1 with the fixture, stored here and read by the builder. `raw-stays.mjs` can write `raw-stays-400.png`, but nothing was saved here and no reading of it is logged.

Nothing here shows that the tests passed. `session.jsonl` has no run result for `test/raw-stays.mjs`, `test/order.mjs`, `test/chat-sent.mjs` or the full suite, and `improvements.jsonl` already says `chat-sent.mjs` fails on michael/dev (task `tn54m85a`). The brief's "every existing case and the full suite still pass" can't be checked from this folder. Log each run's pass/fail lines.

A stale pointer: the new comment at `ux/Dictate/Widget.js:485` and the one in `test/chat-sent.mjs` (around line 105) cite `ux/Dictate/tasks/v1-raw`, which doesn't exist. The task lives at `/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/dictation-v3/v1-raw/`.

The brief asked for a look at the sessions after 21:30 and the voice sessions in `index.jsonl`. The log names only `v-u48msei`, so we don't know whether other sessions show some other way sentences vanish.
The brief said to log the cause in `task.jsonl`, but this dir has `session.jsonl` instead; the cause line is there (line with "Cause found"), which is fine for a fresh agent.

The fix itself is as simple as it gets: one line removed (`parent.style.display = "none"`), with the Question/Task row still inserted after the bubble. The `chat-sent.mjs` check and the new `raw-stays.mjs` both assert the bubble stays visible. I found no other hide path (no CSS on `[data-under]`, no other `style.display` in the Dictate views apart from the playground).
